title: Pointwise ray inequality for C^1 functions (inequality (2.2))
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let φ : R^n → ℝ be C^1 on R^n = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), let x ∈ R^n with |x| ≤ 1, and let τ ≤ 1 be real. Then (1 - τ)|φ(x)|^2 ≤ 2 ∫_{[τ,1]} |φ(t x)|^2 dt + 2 (1 - τ)^2 ∫_{[τ,1]} |∇φ(σ x)|^2 dσ. All integrals are lintegrals over Icc τ 1 for Lebesgue measure on ℝ, |·|^2 are squared extended norms, ∇φ is Mathlib's gradient, and (1 - τ) and (1 - τ)^2 enter via ENNReal.ofReal.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : Rn n → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → ∀ (x : Rn n), ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ τ : ℝ, τ ≤ 1 → ENNReal.ofReal (1 - τ) * ‖φ x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (∫⁻ t in Icc τ 1, ‖φ (t • x)‖ₑ ^ 2) + 2 * ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - τ) ^ 2) * ∫⁻ σ in Icc τ 1, ‖gradient φ (σ • x)‖ₑ ^ 2
